description: A knob with a selectable range that offsets or scales its input signal

params.text: Sets the amount added to or multiplied by the input, within the range currently chosen
Chooses the function applied to the input: ADD offsets it by adding the knob's voltage, MULT scales it by multiplying by the knob's value. Each function has its own set of knob ranges
Cycles the range of the knob while ADD is chosen: 0-5V, -5 to 5V, 0-10V or -10 to 10V
Cycles the range of the knob while MULT is chosen: 0 to 1, -1 to 1, 0 to 2, -2 to 2, 0 to 5, -5 to 5, 0 to 10, or -10 to 10

inputs.text: The signal the function is applied to; with nothing patched the function works on 0V

outputs.text: The input after the chosen offset or scaling

notes: the module is mono: it reads the first channel of a polyphonic cable and ignores the rest, and every output carries a single channel
